description: This file defines the ComplexOperations class, which provides static methods for performing arithmetic operations (+, -, *, /) on complex numbers in a format compatible with Excel functions. It includes methods for division, subtraction, addition, and multiplication of complex numbers, handling both individual values and arrays.

classes.name: ComplexOperations
classes.description: Provides static methods for arithmetic operations on complex numbers within the PhpSpreadsheet calculation engine.

methods.name: IMDIV
methods.description: Performs division of two complex numbers in string format or arrays of complex numbers.

methods.name: IMSUB
methods.description: Calculates the difference between two complex numbers.

methods.name: IMSUM
methods.description: Calculates the sum of multiple complex numbers.

methods.name: IMPRODUCT
methods.description: Calculates the product of multiple complex numbers.
